01 / CURVATURERemove the local reversal.

The new cap retains equal principal curvature at the pole. Quadratic terms adjust its centerline and radial growth through the transition. A constrained fit controls the actual upper and lower profiles. The blend uses a quintic weight with zero first and second derivatives at both ends.

Continuity alone does not establish surface fairness. The profile calculation checks curvature, and matched nTop renders check the visible result.

02 / SHAPE AGREEMENTKeep the B-52F shape.

The source, scale, clean-skin scope, and registration remain unchanged. IoU is the shared silhouette area divided by the combined silhouette area. Each result compares geometry with the same frozen public B-52F artist model.

The local nose and cockpit region measures 99.695% plan and 99.214% side IoU. Doubling the nose sampling changes the global scores by at most 0.000005 percentage points.

These scores measure agreement with the selected public artist model. They do not establish production-aircraft accuracy or aerodynamic performance. Native nTop Automate evaluates the verification probes. No fresh Notebook API readback is claimed for this revision.
